say:1:1330128001:0.text: Zika? Well, the cold was too much for her, so she headed back to Cedartown.
say:1:1330128001:0.source_cn: 你是说齐卡丽？她受不了这里的寒冷，就先回雪松镇等我了。
say:1:1330128001:0.male: Zika? Well, the cold was too much for her, so she headed back to Cedartown.
say:1:1330128001:0.female: Zika? Well, the cold was too much for her, so she headed back to Cedartown.

say:2:1330128002:1.text: I can finally focus on my poetry without her nagging me.
